title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored reserve, geometry-constrained Swiss lever release, and a state-integrated balance whose escapement impulse is now admitted by reconstructed tooth/pallet contact geometry rather than by center crossing alone.

facts.Current pass: M5g center crossing → reconstructed pallet/tooth impulse-path gate → Δω → integrated balance → geometry-constrained train release
